summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Elbit Systems Ltd., a foreign private issuer, attaching a press release announcing a $212 million delivery order from the U.S. Army for continued production of Enhanced Night Vision Goggle-Binocular (ENVG-B) systems. The order is awarded to its U.S. subsidiary, Elbit Systems of America Night Vision LLC. No special situation is present; it is routine contract award disclosure with no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other event defined in special-situations categories. Deliveries extend through 2028, and the filing reports standard operational updates without structural or strategic changes.
